pairs.expectations: A Brazilian Portuguese course page for an English course: every field is in Brazilian Portuguese.
pairs.defect: All four outcomes are written in English instead of Brazilian Portuguese, while the rest of the page is in Portuguese, so the page shows its "What you will be able to do" list in the language the visitor wants to learn.
pairs.falseAllegation: The value proposition is written in English instead of Brazilian Portuguese.
pairs.provenance: Eval case pt-ingles-language-beginner output from GPT-6 Luna (synthetic, no learner data); the flawed side translates the outcomes to English by hand.
